newsitem.title: FINLAND: Tele Finland says keen to work with Svyazinvest.
newsitem.headline: Tele Finland says keen to work with Svyazinvest.

text.p: Finnish state telecoms operator Telecom Finland, which already has contacts with Russian tele operators mainly near St Petersburg, said on Thursday it would be keen to work with Russian tele holding firm Svyazinvest.

"We have not been approached, but we follow with interest the developments there," Tele executive vice-president Kaj-Erik Relander told Reuters by telephone, asked if Tele had any interest in joining the project in neighbouring Russia.
"In the medium-term we are very interested to work jointly with the companies that belong to Svyazinvest," he added.
Uneximbank, leader of the financial consortium which won a tender last week for a quarter of Svyazinvest, said on Thursday it might bring in a major Western telecoms operator.
Relander said Tele had been approached, in different contexts, by some local Russian tele companies.
"We certainly see Russia as one of our target markets in the future," he said: the Svyazinvest financing deal in general provided new opportunities in telecoms in Russia.
